reason: Current protected-main baseline: what list/search already exists, the reserved record_search adapter name, subject registry limits, transport and budget contracts, and the reconciled decisions.
Route implementation to backend database, error, auth, and quality guides.
Raw SQL migrations as single source of truth, index and constraint conventions for the 0056 projection.
Search must apply record visibility and source authorization floor before any field, count, snippet, or facet is returned.
Stable sentinel errors and opaque denials for cursor tamper, expiry, and authorization mismatch.
Comment redaction and notification payload boundaries that indexed content must respect.
Normalized evidence summaries are indexable; forbidden evidence and payload bytes are not.
Route implementation to Web directory, state, styling, and quality guides.
recordsApi stays lazy and out of the eager shell; global search must reach it by dynamic import only.
Lazy route ownership, colocated tests, and the rule that pages do not import app/layout.
Zero net-new CSS budget: the records center composes from existing page.css and atoms.css vocabulary.
Keep query normalization, cursor encoding, SQL, and URL state consistent across layers.
Replace the in-memory q filter rather than adding a second search path beside it.
Non-main branch with hooks; stop before Child 7 activity work.
